Sandbox_DeadWeight_WeighCarried_tooltip: The scale also adds what you carry, worn items and bag contents included, to your body weight. Off: body weight only. On by default. Things lying on the plate are always weighed.
Sandbox_DeadWeight_WholeSquare_tooltip: Off (default): only characters and items standing or lying on the scale sprite itself, in the middle of its square, are weighed. On: anything in the scale's square counts, even beside the sprite.
Sandbox_DeadWeight_ViewDistance_tooltip: How many squares away from the scale you can stand, in the same room, and still read it, like a doctor weighing a patient. 0: only the player on the scale reads it. Default 1.
Sandbox_DeadWeight_HomeScaleSpawn_toolti: How often a Digital Scale turns up inside bathroom counters, the cupboards under a basin. 0: never. Default 3. Only containers filled from now on are affected.
Sandbox_DeadWeight_HomeScaleFloor_toolti: Percent chance that a big enough bathroom nobody has ever seen has a Digital Scale on its floor, against a wall. Only rooms in areas of the map not yet explored are affected. 0: never. Default 20.
